required_work: Close the gap between written checks and enforcing checks: every check the program cites as a bar either gates a merge/certification path, or its record states exactly why not and what closes the gap. A check that exists and gates nothing is a place a future green can mean nothing.
objective: Measured 2026-08-01: the program carries more written checks than enforcing checks. Four concrete cases — (1) the M4 aggregate verifier existed for the whole stage while CI never ran it, which is how verify-m4-goalrun-activation-plane.mjs sat UNRUNNABLE at HEAD since 77117ecd6 with nothing detecting it; (2) check-literal-exit-contract.mjs is honestly red on three cases dispositioned to the proposed m0-authority-admission-census-epoch-successor and is therefore not wired into any battery; (3) check-canon-owner-coverage.mjs is chronically red (385 pre-existing errors, plus 49 surfaced when released predecessors correctly lost hold-exemption) and its own bar is qualified under osh-0025; (4) m4_stage_proof exists in CI but is not marked required in branch protection. M0_NONENFORCING_CHECK_CLOSURE_EXIT=0.
falsifiable_claim: The claim fails if any check cited as a proof bar neither gates an enforcing path nor carries a recorded reason and closure route, if a red check is wired in a way that normalizes overriding it, or if closing the gap weakens any check rather than provisioning or repairing what it measures.
selected_profile: The four measured cases above, plus an enumerable census of every check named by stage modules, package.json, ci.yml, and check:pre-next-leg against what actually gates.
current_implementation_evidence: Filed under the owner's systemic note of 2026-08-01. Progress already landed the same day and disclosed on PR #133: m4_stage_proof exists as a distinct named CI job with count-from-log-bytes enforcement, environmental provisioning (wallet fixture prebuild, cached qwen2.5:7b route), and an M4_ENVIRONMENTAL_PREREQUISITE_FAILED marker separating provisioning gaps from proof regressions; marking it required in branch protection is an owed admin action. check-literal-exit-contract turns green when the authority-admission wave's successor verifies, and is wired as required only then. check-canon-owner-coverage closure is owned by the osh-0025-held M0 bar and its own successor path. TRACKED-CALLER CENSUS BUILT AND RUN 2026-08-04 (queue item 2). Founding run retained as bytes at docs/evidence/m5-event-substrate/negative-control/tracked-caller-census-founding-run.txt with IOI_EXIT_CODE=1 — a census whose discovering run is not retained starts life violating the rule it enforces. It fired on FIVE real uncalled executables; no synthetic was needed, so the tree was NOT clean of the defect this record names. THE LARGEST OFFENDER WAS THE PACKET VALIDATOR: check-claims-coverage.mjs gated the M5 literal while wired to nothing — third instance of this class in one cut, after this record was filed about it and after F-R11 fixed the same defect in the attestation chain. Now wired. FOUR FINDINGS PENDING OWNER RULING, dispositioned STATE-ONLY (uncalled as of the census date, owning program named, intent UNKNOWN) — no claim is made that any is dormant by design, because nobody has said so on the record: apps/hypervisor/scripts/check-augmentation-tokens.mjs and check-source-neutral.mjs (shell-ownership); apps/developers-ioi-ai/scripts/check-live-readiness.mjs and check-seo-routing.mjs (web-estate). Each prints its disposition on every census run so the cost of leaving it uncalled stays visible rather than silent. ONE DEFECT IN THE CENSUS ITSELF, caught on its first run after wiring: listing an executable in the disposition table made it count as CALLED, because the census's own file sits under a caller glob — 61/61 called, 0 warn, dispositions silently not printing. A registry is not a caller. The census now excludes its own file, and the recursion terminates because the census is itself wired and subject to its own rule. OWNER RULING 2026-08-04: all four findings ratified keep-as-manual — the census keeps each on the record, nothing in M5 blocks on them, and wiring is reconsidered when the owning program (shell-ownership; web-estate) next has an active cut. Dispositions in check-tracked-callers.mjs updated from intent-UNKNOWN/pending to ruled keep-as-manual; each still prints on every census run.

positive_proof: Every named check resolves to an enforcing path or a recorded reason with a closure route; the census is regenerable and the tripwire refuses an uncited or unenforced check.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Reject a check cited by a stage module that nothing runs, a required check silently removed from CI, and a census that reports coverage while a named check is unmapped.
compatibility_and_migration: Existing checks keep their names and semantics; only their enforcement wiring and its documentation change.
